goal: Further reduce DiffBuilder internal complexity by moving array/type-dispatch logic for append(Object, Object) into the helper class and keep DiffBuilder method as a thin delegator.

inputs: src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/builder/DiffBuilder.java::public DiffBuilder<T> append(final String fieldName, final Object lhs, final Object rhs)
ops.details: Move the implementation of the append(String, Object, Object) method into DiffBuilderAppenders as a static method that performs the array type dispatch (using ObjectUtils.isArray and instanceof checks) and then calls the appropriate helper append methods for primitive arrays or object arrays. Replace the body in DiffBuilder with a one-line delegation to the new helper method that passes this.diffs and this.equals along with parameters. This centralizes the complex dispatch logic in the helper class.
Ensure any internal calls within DiffBuilder to append(String,Object,Object) now resolve to the delegating method (no change to callers necessary since signature preserved).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
